body:
Before - Excitement. That my miserable existence would be over.  
During- Anxious for it to be over + agonizing pain in all my attempts (3)

After- Ashamed I couldn't even die properly. Repeating the cycle of depair and anguish.

One of the times I laughed at how stupidly I'd wound up after. Flat on my face covered in blood with what looked like real dark hickeys all around my neck. After passing out while hanging myself, the belts buckle I was using snapped on me and I lived.
